shots.beat: The man behind the glass: from behind a grey-haired man in a long coat, Kai beyond the glass. He taps three notes.

camera.focusOn: (()=>{const a=DIR.actor("witness").head.getWorldPosition(new TR.V()), b=DIR.actor("kai").head.getWorldPosition(new TR.V()); const k=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(DIR.t-1.7)/1.0)); const s=k*k*(3-2*k); return a.lerp(b,s);})()

shots.characters: The Witness (back and shoulder only, never his face), Kai behind the glass (in focus)
shots.lighting: Test Hall C lights up on him; the gallery glass reflects; his coat a dark silhouette.
shots.sound: Three notes tapped on the glass (E-B-A), the game's glass voice; then silence.
shots.notes: Spoiler rule: his face and wrist are never in frame. The mission's 'look' clip (it turned his head into profile) is replaced by idle; he keeps his head on Kai, so only the back of his head shows. Focus racks from his grey hair to Kai between shot time 1.7 and 2.7 (under the VO). Taps happen at shot time 1.13, 1.68 and 2.23 s (the game's glass notes), i.e. 69.46, 70.01 and 70.56 s in the edit.

preview.note: Look-dev: over the Witness shoulder (lost profile only, wrist out of frame), focus racks from his grey hair to Kai at the glass. Stills: stills/s19/00012, 00058, 00104.

shots.beat: Montage: Meridian Square at 08:14:00 — commuters under umbrellas and a Continuum trooper stop mid-step, the rain hangs and the square drains of colour; the reset's temporal ripple (back to 08:05) hits on the cut.

setup.eval: import('/src/systems/loops.js').then(m => { const L = m.loopState.active; L.skipTo(535.4); return L.t; })

actions.eval: (() => { const g = __game; let k = 0; const off = g.onUpdate(dt => { k += dt; g.engine.fx.uShift.value = Math.min(0.7, k * 1.8); if (k > 1.2) off(); }); return 1; })()

shots.characters: Seven commuters (citizenLook, umbrellas) walking through the frame at 4-24 m, a second Continuum trooper (Patrol A's look) on patrol by the fountain; all spawned at run time and frozen with the district.
shots.lighting: Rainy morning, the Market Hall's warm windows behind the bronze ring of the fountain; the freeze desaturates to a cold grey.
shots.notes: Camera tracks 2.9 m left at 1.1 m height past the fountain ring toward the Market Hall. The loop is skipped to 535.4 right before frame 0; the game's zero reset freezes the district at loop 538.6 = shot time 3.2 s (uFreeze, freezeAll). At that moment a setup hook also freezes the spawned crowd and holds the rain (the drops shorten into hanging beads, as in mission 1). Action at 4.15 s ramps uShift to 0.7 (the rewind ripple) into the cut. The game's own fade to 08:05 is DOM-only (not captured) and falls in the tail handle. In look-dev a second loop iteration plays the PA cutscene first (game.cine), which delays the reset; the director runs iteration 1, where the storyboard preview showed the freeze on time.

preview.note: The freeze arrives at the end (desaturation). Few people read in the square at preview size.

shots.beat: Montage: Echo Step — Kai sprints at the jammed lockdown shutter; his cyan afterimage holds mid-stride while he slips through.

actions.eval: (()=>{const E=__m12.echo; const ok=E.trigger(); const gh=E.ghost, k=__game.player.char; const col=r=>{const m={}; r.traverse(o=>{if(o.isBone) m[o.name]=o;}); return m;}; const A=col(k.root), B=col(gh.root); let n=0; for(const nm in A){ if(B[nm]){ B[nm].quaternion.copy(A[nm].quaternion); B[nm].position.copy(A[nm].position); n++; } } gh.root.rotation.y=k.root.rotation.y; return [ok,n]; })()

shots.characters: Kai sprinting, his afterimage (holds his sprint pose: the bones are copied at the trigger)
shots.lighting: White lab corridor, the dark shutter with its red lockdown strip and LOCKDOWN sign; the cyan afterimage against the dark shutter.
shots.notes: Setup follows tools/tests/m12.json up to the shutter, then Kai starts a sprint from z -10.5 (Shift+W, 0.3 s before frame 0). Echo Step at shot time 1.1 s (Kai at z -18.3): the afterimage copies his bones so it freezes mid-stride; the dash (0.75 s) arcs him through the shutter, his feet show under the 0.5 m gap on the far side.

preview.note: Look-dev: Kai sprints at the shutter, Echo Step at 1.1 s, the afterimage holds his sprint pose; his feet show under the gap on the far side. Stills: stills/s21/00012, 00040, 00059.

shots.beat: Montage: the Sable Yards held in one second — a courier frozen mid-stride on the dawn street, the rain hanging in the air around him; the camera orbits slowly through the drops.
shots.characters: The held courier (mid-stride), held pedestrians across the street (a woman in red mid-step), Kai not in frame (at the cordon).
shots.lighting: Grey dawn; the shop's red awning and warm windows behind; the held drops catch the light as short streaks.
shots.notes: The coffee-cup close-up was tried and rejected (her frozen clip has her hands on her hips, the cup hangs at knee height, and the cylinder cup reads as a prop). The mission's held rain is sparse (7000 drops over 28 x 7 x 104 m); a setup eval adds 750 more held drops around the courier (the same sprite material, size 0.2, opacity 0.7), kept 1.3 m clear of the camera path, so the parallax through hanging drops reads at 1 s. A 16-degree linear orbit (r 4.15 m) around the courier, focus on him. The incoming 'switch' warp is left to the edit (as for the other switch shots).

preview.note: A rainy 2049 street; that it is held (people mid-step, rain in the air) does not read at preview size.
